title: Console
reasonHint: At least {{min}} letters. It is kept in the audit log.

viewAs.dialogBody: You will see this business's panel read-only for 30 minutes. The business owner will see this access in their audit log.

flags.early_accessHint: Gets new features before everyone else.
flags.extended_historyHint: Can look further back than its plan allows.
flags.beta_featuresHint: Sees features that are still in testing.

metrics.subtitle: Platform-wide numbers (all counts).
metrics.salesSummary: Bar chart: {{total}} sales in the last {{days}} days
metrics.retentionHint: Of the businesses created each week, the percentage that made a sale in week 0, 1, 2… after signing up.

businesses.subtitle: Search by business name or a member's email.

detail.title: Business
detail.flagsHint: Changing a feature asks for a reason.

actions.reasonNote: Every action asks for a reason of at least 5 letters and is kept in the audit log.

trialDialog.title: Extend the trial
trialDialog.body: Adds days to the Pro trial (or starts one if it already ended).

suspendDialog.title: Suspend {{business}}
suspendDialog.body: The business stops being able to operate right away. The reason stays visible here.

deleteDialog.title: Mark {{business}} for deletion
deleteDialog.body: The business stops operating and will be deleted completely after the grace period. This cannot be undone from here.
deleteDialog.type: Type the business name to confirm: {{business}}

users.subtitle: People with an account on the platform.
users.prompt: Type an email or a name to search.

devices.subtitle: Phones with problems: not syncing, or on an old version.
devices.belowHint: Includes phones that report no version.

config.subtitle: Values the app reads on start. An empty value deletes the key and falls back to the environment's.

help.donation_mode: Donation button mode (letters and underscore only).
help.min_app_version: Minimum version: below it the app asks to update. E.g. 1.4.0
help.recommended_app_version: Recommended version: below it the app suggests updating. E.g. 1.5.0

invalid.donation_url: Must start with https:// and have no spaces.
invalid.min_app_version: Use numbers separated by dots, like 1.4.0.
invalid.recommended_app_version: Use numbers separated by dots, like 1.5.0.

announcements.subtitle: They reach the inbox (and push notification) of whoever applies, now or at a set time.
announcements.title: Title
announcements.deepLinkHint: Where it goes when tapped. 200 characters at most.
announcements.audience: Who receives it inside each business
announcements.segmentHint: With no filters it reaches every active business. Separate several values with commas.
announcements.bannerHint: Appears at the top of everyone's app.
announcements.bannerDisabled: Not available with a segment: the banner is for everyone. Remove the filters to use it.
announcements.bannerUntilHint: Empty = until you end it by hand.
announcements.reach: It would reach {{businesses}} businesses and {{people}} people.

problem.businessIds: One of the business IDs is not valid.
problem.bannerSegment: The banner is for everyone: remove the segment.
problem.bannerUntilPast: The banner end must be in the future.
problem.schedulePast: The send time has already passed.

errors.VIEW_AS_READ_ONLY: You are in “View as” mode: it is read-only and does not allow changes.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Write a reason of at least 5 letters.
errors.INVALID_PLAN_STATUS: That plan status does not exist.
errors.INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE: The value is not in a valid format for that key.
errors.BANNER_NEEDS_EVERYONE: The banner is for everyone: remove the segment or turn it off.
errors.INVALID_BANNER_UNTIL: The banner end must be in the future.
errors.INVALID_SCHEDULE: The send time has already passed.
errors.ANNOUNCEMENT_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This announcement was already sent or already cancelled.
